.image-row img { cursor: zoom-in; display: block; height: auto; width: 100%; }

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import html
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path.cwd()
manifest = json.loads((HERE / "report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
samples = manifest.get("samples", [])
failures = manifest.get("failures", [])


def load_json(relative_path):
    try:
        return json.loads((HERE / relative_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        return {}


def show(value, unit=""):
    if value is None or value == "":
        return "—"
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            return "—"
        text = f"{value:.5g}"
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        text = " × ".join(show(item) for item in value)
    else:
        text = str(value)
    return html.escape(f"{text} {unit}".strip())


def line(contents):
    return f'<div class="compact-line">{contents}</div>'


def image_row(result_dir, prefix):
    figures = []
    for filename, caption in (
        ("dirty.png", "Dirty"),
        ("clean.png", "Clean"),
        ("residual.png", "Residual"),
    ):
        source = html.escape(f"{result_dir.rstrip('/')}/{filename}", quote=True)
        alt = html.escape(f"{prefix} {caption}", quote=True)
        figures.append(
            f'<figure><a href="{source}" target="_blank" title="Open full-size {caption}">'
            f'<img src="{source}" alt="{alt}"></a><figcaption>{caption}</figcaption></figure>'
        )
    return '<div class="comparison-row image-row">' + "".join(figures) + "</div>"


def finite_metric(qa, name):
    metrics = qa.get("metrics", {}) or {}
    residual = metrics.get("residual", {}) or {}
    value = metrics.get(name)
    if value is None:
        value = residual.get(name)
    if (
        value is None
        and name == "dynamic_range_scaled_mad"
        and int(qa.get("schema_version", 1)) < 2
    ):
        value = metrics.get("dynamic_range")
    try:
        value = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return value if math.isfinite(value) else None


def metric_region_text(qa):
    if int(qa.get("schema_version", 1)) < 2:
        return "full image (schema 1)"
    region = ((qa.get("metrics", {}) or {}).get("region", {}) or {})
    minimum = region.get("min_radius_beams")
    maximum = region.get("max_radius_beams")
    lower = "centre" if minimum is None else f"{show(minimum)} beams"
    upper = "image edge" if maximum is None else f"{show(maximum)} beams"
    return f"{lower} to {upper}"


def metric_population_signature(qa):
    schema = int(qa.get("schema_version", 1))
    if schema < 2:
        return (schema, None, None)
    region = ((qa.get("metrics", {}) or {}).get("region", {}) or {})
    return (
        schema,
        region.get("min_radius_beams"),
        region.get("max_radius_beams"),
    )


def histogram_svg(original_values, simulation_values, title, x_label, *, log_x=False):
    original = [float(value) for value in original_values if value is not None]
    simulation = [float(value) for value in simulation_values if value is not None]
    if log_x:
        original = [math.log10(value) for value in original if value > 0]
        simulation = [math.log10(value) for value in simulation if value > 0]
    values = original + simulation
    if not values:
        return f'<div class="histogram-panel"><div>{html.escape(title)}: no data</div></div>'

    low, high = min(values), max(values)
    if math.isclose(low, high):
        padding = max(abs(low) * 0.05, 0.5)
        low, high = low - padding, high + padding
    bins = min(14, max(6, int(math.ceil(math.sqrt(len(values))))))
    width = (high - low) / bins

    def counts(series):
        result = [0] * bins
        for value in series:
            index = min(bins - 1, max(0, int((value - low) / width)))
            result[index] += 1
        return result

    original_counts = counts(original)
    simulation_counts = counts(simulation)
    maximum = max(original_counts + simulation_counts + [1])
    svg_width, svg_height = 620, 255
    left, right, top, bottom = 64, 16, 42, 48
    plot_width = svg_width - left - right
    plot_height = svg_height - top - bottom
    bin_width = plot_width / bins
    elements = [
        f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {svg_width} {svg_height}" role="img" aria-label="{html.escape(title, quote=True)}">',
        f'<text x="{left}" y="18" font-size="14">{html.escape(title)}</text>',
        '<rect x="390" y="9" width="11" height="11" fill="#2878b5" opacity="0.72"></rect>',
        '<text x="406" y="18" font-size="11">Original</text>',
        '<rect x="480" y="9" width="11" height="11" fill="#e97821" opacity="0.72"></rect>',
        '<text x="496" y="18" font-size="11">Simulation</text>',
        f'<rect x="{left}" y="{top}" width="{plot_width}" height="{plot_height}" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="0.8"></rect>',
    ]
    for index, (original_count, simulation_count) in enumerate(
        zip(original_counts, simulation_counts)
    ):
        x = left + index * bin_width
        half = max(1.0, bin_width / 2 - 1)
        for offset, count, color in (
            (1, original_count, "#2878b5"),
            (bin_width / 2, simulation_count, "#e97821"),
        ):
            height = plot_height * count / maximum
            elements.append(
                f'<rect x="{x + offset:.2f}" y="{top + plot_height - height:.2f}" '
                f'width="{half:.2f}" height="{height:.2f}" fill="{color}" opacity="0.72">'
                f'<title>{"Original" if color == "#2878b5" else "Simulation"}: {count}</title></rect>'
            )
    for index in range(5):
        fraction = index / 4
        value = low + fraction * (high - low)
        display_value = 10**value if log_x else value
        x = left + fraction * plot_width
        elements.append(
            f'<line x1="{x:.2f}" y1="{top + plot_height}" x2="{x:.2f}" y2="{top + plot_height + 4}" stroke="#555"></line>'
        )
        elements.append(
            f'<text x="{x:.2f}" y="{top + plot_height + 17}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10">{display_value:.3g}</text>'
        )
        y_value = round(fraction * maximum)
        y = top + plot_height - fraction * plot_height
        elements.append(
            f'<text x="{left - 7}" y="{y + 3:.2f}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10">{y_value}</text>'
        )
    label = x_label + (" (log-spaced bins)" if log_x else "")
    elements.extend(
        [
            f'<text x="{left + plot_width / 2:.2f}" y="{svg_height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11">{html.escape(label)}</text>',
            f'<text x="14" y="{top + plot_height / 2:.2f}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" transform="rotate(-90 14 {top + plot_height / 2:.2f})">Count</text>',
            "</svg>",
        ]
    )
    return (
        '<div class="histogram-panel">'
        + "".join(elements)
        + f'<div class="histogram-note">Original n={len(original)}; simulation n={len(simulation)}</div></div>'
    )


print(f"<h1>{html.escape(str(manifest.get('title', 'VLA comparison report')))}</h1>")
print(f'<p class="report-description">{html.escape(str(manifest.get("description", "")))}</p>')
print('<div class="report-summary">')
print(f"Completed pairs: {len(samples)} / {show(manifest.get('total_samples'))}<br>")
print(f"Failed samples: {len(failures)}")
if failures:
    details = "; ".join(
        f"{item.get('id', '—')} ({item.get('stage', 'unknown stage')}: {item.get('error', '—')})"
        for item in failures
    )
    print(f'<div class="failure-list">{html.escape(details)}</div>')
print("</div>")

population_qa = [
    (
        load_json(Path(sample["original_result_dir"]) / "qa.json"),
        load_json(Path(sample["simulation_result_dir"]) / "qa.json"),
    )
    for sample in samples
]
population_schema_versions = {
    int(qa.get("schema_version", 1))
    for pair in population_qa
    for qa in pair
    if qa
}
population_metric_regions = {
    metric_population_signature(qa)
    for pair in population_qa
    for qa in pair
    if qa
}
declared_region_policy = (
    (manifest.get("configuration", {}) or {}).get("metric_region_policy") or {}
)
paired_metric_regions_match = all(
    metric_population_signature(original) == metric_population_signature(simulation)
    for original, simulation in population_qa
    if original and simulation
)
population_metrics_comparable = (
    len(population_schema_versions) <= 1
    and (
        len(population_metric_regions) <= 1
        or (bool(declared_region_policy) and paired_metric_regions_match)
    )
)
histogram_specs = (
    ("dynamic_range_scaled_mad", "Measured robust image dynamic range", "global clean peak / selected residual scaled MAD", True),
    ("scaled_mad_jy_per_beam", "Residual scaled MAD", "Jy/beam", True),
    ("peak_over_scaled_mad", "Residual peak / scaled MAD", "ratio", False),
    ("p99_over_scaled_mad", "Residual p99 / scaled MAD", "ratio", False),
    ("rms_over_scaled_mad", "Residual RMS / scaled MAD", "ratio", False),
)
print('<section class="distribution-section">')
print("<h2>Original and simulation metric distributions</h2>")
if not population_metrics_comparable:
    print('<p class="failure-list">Population histograms are suppressed because the QA files use different metric schemas or beam-region bounds.</p>')
print('<div class="histogram-grid">')
for metric, title, x_label, log_x in histogram_specs:
    print(
        histogram_svg(
            [] if not population_metrics_comparable else [finite_metric(original, metric) for original, _ in population_qa],
            [] if not population_metrics_comparable else [finite_metric(simulation, metric) for _, simulation in population_qa],
            title,
            x_label,
            log_x=log_x,
        )
    )
print("</div></section>")

for sample in samples:
    original_qa = load_json(Path(sample["original_result_dir"]) / "qa.json")
    simulation_qa = load_json(Path(sample["simulation_result_dir"]) / "qa.json")
    simulation = load_json(sample["simulation_metadata"])
    parameters = original_qa.get("effective_imaging_parameters", {})
    resolved = original_qa.get("resolved_config", {}) or {}
    resolved_grid = resolved.get("grid", {}) or {}
    image_grid = resolved_grid.get("image_grid", {}) or {}
    geometry = parameters.get("measured_geometry", {}) or {}
    beam = geometry.get("beam", resolved_grid.get("beam", {})) or {}
    noise = simulation.get("noise", {}) or {}
    resolved_noise = noise.get("resolved_parameters", {}) or {}
    components = simulation.get("components", []) or []
    component = components[0] if components else {}
    flux = (component.get("flux") or [None])[0]
    mask_nbeams = parameters.get("mask_nbeams")
    mask = (
        f"central circle ({show(mask_nbeams)} beams)"
        if mask_nbeams is not None
        else show(parameters.get("mask"))
    )

    parameter_lines = [
        line(f"deconvolver={show(parameters.get('deconvolver'))}, nterms={show(parameters.get('nterms'))}"),
        line(f"specmode={show(parameters.get('specmode'))}, gridder={show(parameters.get('gridder'))}, stokes={show(parameters.get('stokes'))}"),
        line(f"weighting={show(parameters.get('weighting'))}, robust={show(parameters.get('robust'))}"),
        line(f"imsize={show(geometry.get('imsize', image_grid.get('imsize', parameters.get('imsize'))))} px, cell={show(geometry.get('cell_arcsec', image_grid.get('cell_arcsec', parameters.get('cell'))))} arcsec"),
        line(f"mask={mask}, mask_nbeams={show(mask_nbeams)}"),
        line(f"niter={show(parameters.get('niter'))}, nsigma={show(parameters.get('nsigma'))}, threshold={show(parameters.get('threshold'))}, cycleniter={show(parameters.get('cycleniter'))}"),
        line(f"beam={show(beam.get('major_arcsec'))} × {show(beam.get('minor_arcsec'))} arcsec, PA={show(beam.get('position_angle_deg'))} deg"),
    ]

    def metric_lines(qa):
        metrics = qa.get("metrics", {}) or {}
        residual = metrics.get("residual", metrics) or {}
        region = metrics.get("region", {}) or {}
        robust_dr = metrics.get("dynamic_range_scaled_mad", metrics.get("dynamic_range"))
        values = [
            line(f"metric region={metric_region_text(qa)}; area={show(residual.get('area_synthesized_beams'))} synthesized beams"),
            line(f"residual RMS={show(residual.get('rms_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
            line(f"scaled MAD={show(residual.get('scaled_mad_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
            line(f"residual |peak|={show(residual.get('residual_abs_peak_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
            line(f"residual min/max={show(residual.get('residual_min_jy_per_beam'))} / {show(residual.get('residual_max_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
            line(f"peak/scaled MAD={show(residual.get('peak_over_scaled_mad'))}"),
            line(f"p99/scaled MAD={show(residual.get('p99_over_scaled_mad'))}"),
            line(f"p99.5/scaled MAD={show(residual.get('p99_5_over_scaled_mad'))}"),
            line(f"measured DR (clean peak/residual RMS)={show(metrics.get('dynamic_range_rms'))}"),
            line(f"measured robust DR (clean peak/scaled MAD)={show(robust_dr)}"),
        ]
        if qa.get("warnings"):
            values.append(line("warnings=" + html.escape("; ".join(map(str, qa["warnings"])))))
        return values

    simulation_lines = [
        line("source=phase-centre point (constant spectrum, unpolarized)"),
        line(f"target S/N from original dynamic range={show(sample.get('target_dynamic_range', sample.get('source_snr')))}"),
        line(f"achieved simulation robust DR={show(finite_metric(simulation_qa, 'dynamic_range_scaled_mad'))}"),
        line(f"source flux={show(flux, 'Jy')}"),
        line(f"predicted thermal image RMS={show(sample.get('predicted_image_rms_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}"),
        line(f"noise model={show(noise.get('noise_model'))}"),
        line(f"band={show(resolved_noise.get('band'))}, sampler={show(resolved_noise.get('sampler'))} (declared)"),
        line(f"SEFD={show(resolved_noise.get('sefd_jy'), 'Jy')}, eta_c={show(resolved_noise.get('eta_c'))}"),
        line(f"simplenoise={show(noise.get('simplenoise_jy'), 'Jy')}, seed={show(noise.get('seed'))}"),
    ]

    sample_id = html.escape(str(sample.get("id", "—")))
    print('<div class="sample-pair">')
    print('<div class="comparison-row info-row original-info">')
    print(f'<div><div class="sample-id">{sample_id}</div><div class="ms-path">{html.escape(str(sample.get("original_ms", "—")))}</div></div>')
    print("<div>" + "".join(parameter_lines) + "</div>")
    print("<div>" + "".join(metric_lines(original_qa)) + "</div>")
    print("</div>")
    print(image_row(str(sample["original_result_dir"]), sample_id))
    print('<div class="comparison-row info-row simulation-info">')
    print(f'<div><div class="sample-id">{sample_id} simulation</div>' + "".join(simulation_lines) + "</div>")
    print("<div></div>")
    print("<div>" + "".join(metric_lines(simulation_qa)) + "</div>")
    print("</div>")
    print(image_row(str(sample["simulation_result_dir"]), f"{sample_id} simulation"))
    print("</div>")
```
